posts.title: Frankenstein's pattern: When design system components get stitched together (Zeroheight)
posts.description: When too many functions and interaction types get stitched into a single component, the result is harder to use, harder to maintain, and harder to access, and deadline pressure and AI-assisted workflows keep producing more of them.

posts.title: How accessibility gets lost between base and product design systems (Zeroheight)
posts.description: Accessibility often erodes in the handoff from base to product design systems, but product teams can close those gaps with better defaults, clearer documentation, and smarter, deliberate deviations.

posts.title: Designing with Mustard
posts.description: Designing with mustard is the future of design. I used to think it was ketchup, but I was wrong. If you're not currently designing with mustard, you should get out of design and tech. The future of design is mustard. Adapt or perish.
